brief:
Israeli strikes killed at least 16 Palestinians across the Gaza Strip over the past 24 hours, according to an Al Jazeera count of the death toll. The casualties resulted from various attacks carried out during the period.

No additional details regarding the locations of the strikes, circumstances of the attacks, or identification of the victims were provided in the available information.
dek: Israeli strikes kill at least 16 Palestinians across Gaza over past day An Al Jazeera count of the death toll has estimated that at least 16 Palestinians have been killed in various Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip over the past 24 hours.
title: Israeli strikes kill 16 Palestinians across Gaza in 24 hours
